claim_verdicts.evidence: Claim now reads exactly as the R1 suggested_text. Kanban Guide (kanbanguides.org, R1 WebFetch): members 'should start work on an item (pull or select) only when there is a clear signal that there is capacity to do so'; the guide prescribes no sprints or time-boxes. Repo kanban-board-example.md@stage-1 lines 3-4: 'Đội không chia sprint ... việc vào bảng bất cứ lúc nào, xếp theo mức ưu tiên'. Lesson wording 'does not need either' (sec 6) matches.

Scrum Guide 2020: Sprints 'are fixed length events of one month or less to create consistency.' 'The Sprint Backlog is composed of the Sprint Goal (why), the set of Product Backlog items selected for the Sprint (what), as well as an actionable plan for delivering the Increment (how).' WebFetch search of the page found no occurrence of 'board', 'Kanban' or 'column' and no guidance on how to display the Sprint Backlog (negative result from a processed summary).

git show stage-1:docs/team/kanban-board-example.md and tools/extract-code --lines 8-12 / 24-28: both blocks match character-for-character. Lines 24-26: 'Nhóm hỗ trợ (Dev 1, Dev 2) ... Đội tính năng (Dev 3, Dev 4) vẫn dùng sprint riêng'. Note: line 10 puts Dev 3 (feature team) in 'Đang làm' on this board - see issue on section 5.
git show stage-1:docs/team/sprint-example.md line 17: '| Ngừng gửi thông báo cho đơn đã hủy | Dev 3 | 2 | Chưa xong, chuyển sprint sau |'.

Scrum Guide 2020: 'The Sprint Backlog is composed of the Sprint Goal (why), the set of Product Backlog items selected for the Sprint (what), as well as an actionable plan' - per Sprint, so a new Sprint brings new items. Combination: Kanban Guide (R1) says Kanban 'can and should be used to augment' other delivery techniques. Claim as written ('can be combined') is supported; the lesson text still says 'Many teams mix them' - see issue.

Scrum Guide 2020 (WebFetch 2026-09-28): 'Sprint Planning initiates the Sprint by laying out the work to be performed for the Sprint.' 'The Developers select items from the Product Backlog to include in the current Sprint.' 'The Sprint is a container for all other events' - Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective. Lesson's 'meeting ... where the team chooses its work' and 'meetings (daily, review, retrospective)' are acceptable L1 glosses.

issues.text: Unlisted claims introduced in R1/junior fixes (all supportable, none in the ledger): (a) 'keeps that goal fixed for the sprint' - Scrum Guide: 'No changes are made that would endanger the Sprint Goal'; (b) 'The Scrum Guide, the short official description of Scrum' - Guide: 'The Scrum Guide contains the definition of Scrum.'; (c) sec 5 '(giới hạn 2) ... means "limit 2": at most two items may sit there at once' - repo kanban-board-example.md:14-19.
issues.quote: Scrum plans a batch around a sprint goal and keeps that goal fixed for the sprint
issues.fix: Meta only, no prose change: extend claim 2 with 'No changes are made during the Sprint that would endanger the Sprint Goal; the Scrum Guide contains the definition of Scrum.' Extend claim 3 with 'lines 14-19 explain that giới hạn 2 means at most two items in the column; a full column blocks new work.'

issues.text: Ledger/lesson mismatch: claim 5 says 'Scrum and Kanban can be combined', but section 4 and summary line 5 still state prevalence ('Many teams mix them', 'many teams mix them'), which no pinned source supports. Wording comes from outline item 3, so not a blocker.
issues.quote: Many teams mix them, for example keeping Scrum's roles and meetings
issues.fix: Either change section 4 to 'Teams can mix them, for example ...' and summary line 5 to '... and a team can mix them', or add to claim 5 a separate sentence 'Many teams mix them' with kind opinion.

issues.text: Stated flatly, but Scrum Guide 2020 allows mid-sprint change: 'Scope may be clarified and renegotiated with the Product Owner as more is learned', as long as the Sprint Goal is not endangered. An urgent wrong-total bug could enter a running sprint. Removing 'unless the sprint is changed' (junior fix) made the answer absolute.
issues.quote: the feature team at its next sprint planning
issues.fix: Try it expected result 3: 'the feature team usually at its next sprint planning.' No further explanation needed.

issues.text: Carried from R1, now sharper: the lesson explicitly teaches that Đang làm (giới hạn 2) holds at most two items and it is full (sec 5, Try it result 3), yet option a still says being free is enough. Still the only defensible option, so not a wrong key.
issues.quote: When someone is free to pull it into `Đang làm`
issues.fix: Option a (en/vi): 'When there is room in `Đang làm` and someone pulls it' / 'Khi `Đang làm` còn chỗ và có người kéo nó sang'; same idea in explanation.correct (en/vi).

issues.quote: It shows the sprint backlog, which belongs to one sprint
issues.fix: Replace 'the sprint backlog' with 'the items the team chose for this sprint' in section 4 and in q2 stem (en/vi).

issues.text: 'the Scrum Guide' appears as if I know it is a document with authority. Nothing I have read names it; I cannot tell why its silence settles the board question. Also used in q2 explanation b.

issues.fix: Add in the sentence: 'The Scrum Guide, the short official description of Scrum, does not say...'.

issues.text: 'sprint planning' is used as a named event (section 6, Try it result 3, quiz q3 option b) but my prereq summary never names it. Section 4 only says 'a planning meeting'. I can guess, but I have to guess.

issues.text: 'events' as a Scrum word is unknown to me. I know roles from the prereq summary, and meetings like the daily and retrospective, but not that they are called 'events'.

issues.fix: Replace 'roles and events' with 'roles and meetings (daily, review, retrospective)'.

issues.text: The column headers say '(giới hạn 2)' (limit 2), but the prose translating the columns drops it and never says what a limit does. Then Try it result 3 depends on it: 'once an item leaves the full Đang làm column'. I would not know why a free person cannot just start the urgent bug.
issues.quote: Four columns: `Việc cần làm` (to do), `Đang làm` (in progress), `Chờ review` (waiting for review) and `Xong` (done).
issues.fix: Add one sentence after the column list: 'Đang làm and Chờ review each say giới hạn 2: at most two items may sit there, so a new item waits until one moves on; the next lesson explains why.'
